rationale: The Dutch District Court of Gelderland decision explicitly concerns hydrology and a Water Act project plan ('Projectplan. Waterwet.', the statutory instrument under Art. 5.4 Waterwet used by water authorities/waterboards for constructing or modifying water management works, reviewed with STAB expert advice alongside Art. 8 ECHR and Art. 12(1) ICESCR). It is substantively about systemic water governance under the Waterwet and does not involve household service connection refusal or informal settlements.
